✨ ProxyBridge | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide transparent system-wide proxying for TCP and UDP traffic on Windows, macOS, and Linux, allowing users to route traffic through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies on a per-application basis.
✨ Key Features: • Universal proxy client for Windows, macOS, and Linux • Transparent proxy routing for TCP and UDP traffic • Supports SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies
📖 Summary: ProxyBridge is a universal proxy client for Windows, macOS, and Linux that acts as a Proxifier alternative. It enables transparent redirection of TCP and UDP traffic from applications through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, allowing granular control over traffic routing, blocking, or allowing on a per-application basis.
